# DeedCode

> DeedCode is a Nairobi, Kenya web studio founded by Duncan K. Kigen. We build fast, mobile-first websites for African churches, ministries, NGOs and charities, with M-Pesa STK Push and global card giving, a 24-hour fixed-price quote and a 90-day money-back guarantee.

## Pages
- [Church websites](https://deedcode.com/church): M-Pesa giving, first-time visitor guide, low-data sermon hub, WhatsApp follow-up
- [NGO and charity websites](https://deedcode.com/ngos): multi-currency donations, live impact trackers, automated donor receipts
- [Services and pricing](https://deedcode.com/services): Starter Web, Impact Hub, Enterprise Suite
- [Our work](https://deedcode.com/work): live sites at lusegatales.com and talesbytitus.com
- [About and founder](https://deedcode.com/about): Duncan K. Kigen, founder of DeedCode
- [Free digital audit](https://deedcode.com/audit): free review and fixed-price plan within 24 hours
- [Contact](https://deedcode.com/contact): WhatsApp +254 703 545 010, info@deedcode.com
